Handler AST changes require human review; they do not by themselves prove a wire incompatibility.
Only implemented routes/fields are marked used; extend this baseline when adding controls.
No server credentials, source execution or automatic baseline updates.

All ten source modules existed at the original F0 baseline; the 287 new selected keys are identical at stable B200. Existing handler hashes/variants and baseline commit remain intact. See contracts/2026-11-05-kanban-board-controls.md.
